_note: Passive-cooling interventions. effect fields: wallU / roofU / wallAlpha / roofAlpha replace the baseline; glazingShadingMult and wallExposureMult multiply; achAdd adds air changes per hour. costBasis picks the quantity the unit cost applies to. Costs are rough ₹ estimates; verify against CPWD Delhi DSR before quoting.

interventions.name: Jali Screen
interventions.description: Filters direct sun on windows while letting air through.
interventions.heritage: Jali screens in Mughal and Rajasthani havelis

interventions.name: Chhajja Overhang
interventions.description: Deep projecting slab above windows that blocks high sun.
interventions.heritage: Deep chhajjas on Rajasthani and Delhi havelis

interventions.name: Aangan Courtyard
interventions.description: Open courtyard that shades inner walls and drives stack ventilation. In retrofit it becomes a light-well.
interventions.heritage: Central courtyard of the traditional Indian house
interventions.source: Courtyard cooling of roughly 2-6 °C reported in the literature

interventions.name: Lime Cool Roof
interventions.description: Lime-wash or reflective whitewash that lowers roof solar absorption.
interventions.heritage: Lime plaster and whitewash on traditional roofs
interventions.source: Solar absorptance drops from about 0.7 to 0.4

interventions.name: Green Roof
interventions.description: Soil and vegetation layer that insulates the roof and cools it by evapotranspiration.
interventions.heritage: Earth-covered and terrace-garden roofs in vernacular design

interventions.name: Rat-trap Bond Wall
interventions.description: Cavity brick wall with an air gap that cuts heat transfer through the wall.
interventions.heritage: Rat-trap bond, popularised by Laurie Baker

interventions.name: Khus Chik Screen
interventions.description: Wet khus grass screen over openings. Evaporation cools the incoming air.
interventions.heritage: Khus tattis used in North Indian homes before air conditioning
interventions.source: Shading of about 20% plus evaporative cooling worth about 1 K in dry air. The evaporative part scales with dryness (see heatModel.js). Needs regular watering. Assumed, not measured.

interventions.name: Clerestory Ventilator
interventions.description: High openings that let hot air escape and drive cross-ventilation.
interventions.heritage: Roshandan high vents in traditional houses
